the_line: Lean proves that a conclusion follows from stated premises. It does not adjudicate reality. Every theorem in this repo is of the form 'if these premises hold, then this follows', and a kernel proof of it is silent on whether any organism satisfies the premises. So a grand question has a formalisable core exactly to the extent that part of the disagreement about it is a disagreement about what follows from what, and an empirical remainder exactly to the extent that it is a disagreement about what the world is like. Most of these questions are mostly remainder. Two of them (the Price equation, Hamilton's rule) are disputes in which the formal part has been repeatedly confused with the empirical part for decades, and those are the ones where formalisation would do the most good. A capability map that let the first kind of progress be read as the second would be worse than no map.
name: Hamilton's rule and its generality
question: Does relatedness times benefit exceeding cost explain altruism in general, or only under assumptions that rarely hold?
dispute: Nowak, Tarnita and Wilson 2010 argued that inclusive-fitness theory has been of little explanatory value; 137 authors replied in Abbot et al. 2011; Gardner, West and Wild 2011 defended the rule's generality formally; Birch, and Birch and Okasha, argue that the dispute turns on the difference between a general form that is a tautologous rearrangement and a restricted form with substantive premises. Fifteen years of it, and the formal half has never been mechanically settled.

statements.claim: If the change in mean breeding value takes the Price form dp = k(rb - c) with k > 0 and 0 <= r <= 1, where b and c are the partial regressions of fitness on the partner's and the actor's genotype, then the trait increases if and only if c < rb.
statements.settles: That the GENERAL form is a theorem under those definitions, and therefore has no empirical content on its own: it cannot be refuted by any data until the coefficients are measured. Proved here as a candidate law. Read the premise carefully: the Price form is a NAMED HYPOTHESIS of this law, not something derived from a proved Price identity, so what is settled is the biconditional and not the Price form itself. Deriving that premise is what the missing Price module would do.

statements.claim: If interactions are pairwise, selection is weak, and fitness effects are additive, then rb greater than c with r the pedigree coefficient of relatedness implies the altruistic allele increases.
statements.settles: That the RESTRICTED form is a substantive theorem whose premises can fail. Its premises become visible and checkable, which is what the dispute needs.

statements.claim: There exists a model with stated non-additive fitness effects, satisfying pairwise interaction and pedigree relatedness, in which rb exceeds c and the allele nevertheless decreases.
statements.settles: That the restricted form does NOT follow without additivity. This is a counter-model, not a failed proof attempt, and it is the formal content of one side of the dispute. No tool here can produce or certify one.

items.what: Whether real eusocial systems satisfy the restricted form's premises (additivity, weak selection, pairwise interaction).
items.why_not_provable: A fact about particular social insects.
items.measurement: Fitness effects measured for interacting pairs and for groups, with the interaction tested for additivity rather than assumed.

items.what: Whether relatedness is high in the populations where eusociality arose.
items.why_not_provable: A measurement about pedigrees and population structure.
items.measurement: Genotyping of colonies and estimation of within-colony relatedness, in the clades where eusociality originated.

items.what: Whether inclusive-fitness accounting or multilevel accounting is more useful in practice.
items.why_not_provable: A question about scientific practice; both are formally valid if the general forms are theorems.
items.measurement: Not measurable. Judged by whether each framing has generated predictions that were then tested.

in_repo.note: The general form, proved as a biconditional from a named hypothesis that ASSUMES the Price form dp = k(rb - c). It is a candidate, so it is in no law set and judges no design. What it settles is that rb > c is equivalent to increase GIVEN that form; it does not establish the form, and it says nothing about the restricted form or about eusociality.

in_repo.ref: Delphi.variance, Delphi.meanFitness, Delphi.select over a Fintype index
in_repo.note: Finite-population frequency machinery suitable for a regression-based relatedness definition. Nothing about relatedness or social interaction exists here yet.

tools_needed.name: lean_module_price_equation
tools_needed.note: The general form of Hamilton's rule is a rearrangement of the Price equation, so the Price module is a prerequisite and not an alternative.

tools_needed.name: lean_module_hamilton_rule
tools_needed.note: The general form is now a candidate law. What is still missing: the Price identity its named hypothesis assumes, the restricted form proved from pairwise interaction, weak selection and additivity, and a counter-model showing the restricted form fails without additivity.

tools_needed.name: lean_counter_model
tools_needed.note: Needed for the third statement: certifying that the restricted form does NOT hold without additivity. Today the registry can prove a contradiction between two laws but cannot certify a non-consequence.

tools_needed.name: data_relatedness_eusocial
tools_needed.note: Within-colony relatedness and measured fitness effects for the origins of eusociality. The empirical half needs data this project does not have and has no route to.

scope: This is a map of what is formalisable, not a research programme and not a claim that the formalisable parts are the important parts. The (a)/(b) split is a judgement made here and is arguable for every entry; where it is contentious the dispute field says so. The list is not exhaust: there is no canonical set of grand questions in biology, and this one is weighted toward evolution, development and scaling because that is what this project reads. Several entries have no counterpart in open-problems/problems.json, which is a gap in that enumeration rather than evidence the question is settled. Nothing here is about the held-out exam clade.
